formal_statement: ∀ s : ℕ, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize 6 (fun x : Fin 6 → Bool => (x 0 && x 1) || (x 2 && x 3) || (x 3 && x 4) || (x 4 && x 5) || (x 5 && x 2)) s ↔ 5 ≤ s
plain_statement: The graph on vertices 0 to 5 with edges 0-1, 2-3, 3-4, 4-5, 5-2 (the 4-cycle and a disjoint edge; 5 edges, least vertex cover 3). Its edge function on 6 inputs, x0 x1 OR x2 x3 OR x3 x4 OR x4 x5 OR x5 x2, true when both ends of some edge are true, has a circuit of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two (every gate counted) with at most s gates exactly when s >= 5.
title: Exact circuit size: the edge function of the 4-cycle and a disjoint edge has circuits with s gates exactly when s >= 5
